paper_metadata.title: 10-Gb/s Limiting Amplifier and Laser/Modulator Driver in 0.18-m CMOS Technology
paper_metadata.abstract: A limiting amplifier incorporates active feedback, inductive peaking, and negative Miller capacitance to achieve a voltage gain of 50 dB, a bandwidth of 9.4 GHz, and a sensitivity 12 while consuming of 4.6 mVpp for a bit-error rate of 10 150 mW. A driver employs T-coil peaking and negative impedance conversion to achieve operation at 10 Gb/s while delivering a current of 100 mA to 25lasers or a voltage swing of 2 Vpp to 50modulators with a power dissipation of 675 mW. Fabricated in 0.18m CMOS technology, both prototypes operate with a 1.8-V supply.
